question: Should OpenClaw sponsor Buzz as an official external channel plugin and authorize the exact `nostr-tools` dependency graph for this head?
rationale: The PR creates an official catalog/release surface, adds credential-bearing relay authentication, and cannot satisfy the repository’s external dependency-graph policy through an ordinary contributor patch alone.

options.title: Sponsor and authorize after proof
options.body: Approve Buzz as an official channel direction, authorize the current dependency graph through the required security/admin path, and require inspectable redacted relay proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the integration external
options.body: Decline official-catalog inclusion and ask for publication through the external plugin path without adding this dependency graph to the repository.

options.title: Pause for security architecture review
options.body: Hold the PR until an owner reviews the relay-auth, private-key, and dependency packaging model in detail.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and authorize after proof
recommendation.body: Approve Buzz as an official channel direction, authorize the current dependency graph through the required security/admin path, and require inspectable redacted relay proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current integration and most of its corrective work, so they are the best available technical contact while an authorized repository owner makes the product and dependency decision.
